column1: # Doc-test floors — a RATCHET over *executed* doctests, per crate (#1373).
# Why `executed` and not `discovered`: `cargo test --doc` prints `running 16 tests`
# for crate `rigorix_engine` and then executes **six**. The other ten are
# ```ignore examples on public APIs, which are never compiled and never run, so a
# floor over the discovered count would certify a channel that runs nothing.
#   * A crate absent from this file has no floor and is only reported.
#   * Falling below a floor fails `run-doctests.sh` with the crate named.
#   * Raising a floor is a normal edit; lower it only with the reason in the commit.
#   * `cargo nextest` runs no doctests, so this file is the only record that the
#     channel still carries anything — hence it is a floor, not a target.
